note: All 47 routes below were driven by tools/boot-check.js (data-pm2-route stamp, zero console errors/warnings, no horizontal overflow) at 1280px, and the full default battery also at 760/900/2500px. Provider object tabs (accounts/models/limits/routing/installs/setup/activity/advanced, plus free-community routes/catalog and opencode server) walked additionally. Location contract: every non-Home surface (managers, domains, domain subgroups, All, Copy, Search, missing-setting fallback) carries a persistent quiet 'Back to <named parent>' pill in the sticky beacon bar with the required data-pm2-back hook, at ALL widths (crumbs hide at <=900 but the named Back pill stays); the copy flow's step-back buttons carry the hook too. Search inputs carry data-pm2-search-input (orchestrator patch).
